baselineDescription: current deferred multi-issuer candidate, not main
candidateDescription: strict per-file clonefileat with one reusable source/destination directory pair per bounded worker; hints and checks unchanged
caveats: Local loaded host; not an independent hosted result.
Both executables were built before timing. No stack observer or stage probes enabled; no other local build or benchmark overlapped.
The worker-state reuse regression failed with per-item initialization before the stateful worker change.
Additional test-only coverage was added after building the measured executable. A subsequent release rebuild reproduced its exact SHA-256.
An initial invalid-UTF-8 creation fixture failed at setup on APFS; the corrected regression verifies Unicode cloning and byte-preserving native error paths.
No samples are excluded. Cached handles did not justify additional resource-lifetime complexity.
These measurements neither identify nor resolve the earlier hosted concurrent timeout.
